The Opportunity

Turn unused footfall into a recurring income line.

Every day, people pass through your space — students, employees, patients, visitors, residents — and every one of them is a potential vending sale. Right now, that footfall earns your organization nothing. A Vendi 'N' Go machine turns it into a line item on your monthly income statement, without asking your team to lift a finger.

Unused footfall, unmonetized

Radical Transparency

See exactly what your machine earns. In real time.

Why Vendi 'N' Go

Everything you gain. Nothing you manage.

01

Zero Investment

You don't purchase the machine or pay for installation. Vendi 'N' Go funds and installs the entire setup.

02

Zero Electricity Cost

We cover the machine's power consumption in full. Your electricity bill doesn't change.

03

10% Monthly Revenue Share

A transparent, live-tracked share of every month's sales — paid to your organization, not negotiated after the fact.

04

Full Maintenance Included

Servicing, repairs, software updates, and preventive maintenance are entirely on us.

05

Automatic Restocking

Our operations team monitors inventory remotely and restocks before the machine ever runs dry.

06

A Real Amenity

Snacks, beverages, and daily essentials available to your people, on-site, whenever they need them — no extra facilities burden on you.
